dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Well, <$cdef(27)>Prinplup? Do you finally understand how awesome
my mane is?

<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>No, <$cdef(27)>Zoroark... I think it’s time for you to acknowledge the
superiority of crests.

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Grrrrrr... But manes are fluffy and feel so nice to touch!
<$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>A hard, bulky crest can’t compete with that!

<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,7)>But when it rains, your mane gets flat and matted, no?
On the other hand, crests <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>stand tall and proud no matter
the weather. They’re better. End of discussion.

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Ughhh... We’re not gettin’ anywhere. Guess we’ll just have
to ask <$cdef(27)>!<$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Hey, bud! Which do YOU think is better?! Manes, right?
I bet you prefer manes!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>It’s simple if you stop to think about it. Which is more
appealing? The answer is clearly crests. <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Yes?
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,4)>But...why? Crests are clearly superior...

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Heck yeah, bud! I knew you’d be on my side! I’ll let ya
touch my mane sometime! <$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,8)>Just once, though! I don’t let
anyone touch my mane!
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>No way... Seriously? But...but...manes are the BEST...

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I knew you’d understand, <$cdef(27)>.
We should get together sometime to discuss the many
charms of crests in greater detail.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Tell me, Clodsire—what food do you think is the tastiest?
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,806)>*yaaawn*... Hmmm... That’s a tough one...<$facial(2,14)><$kfacial(2)>

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,666)>It is, isn’t it? I could never choose between crisp, crunchy
carrots <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,663)><$comeff(2,15)>and irresistibly juicy tomatoes.
<$comcan(1)>Zzz... <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)>Mmm... <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(2340)></color> are the best...

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, so you like <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,666)>I’m with you there. That tantalizing flavor... It never gets
old, no matter how many I eat.
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)>Mmmeheh... So yummy... Zzzzzz...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>You know, earlier I spotted a tree with <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>
growing on it. <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>If you really like them so much, want me to
go grab some for you?
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,663)>Oh no... I can’t eat another bite...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Oh? I’m surprised to hear that coming from you.
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,666)>Zzz... I’ll eat the rest tomorrow...

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>The rest...? Well, I’m sure there’ll be plenty of berries left
tomorrow. <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>I can always bring you some another time.

<$voicel(2,3)>Mmm... Y’know what, one more wouldn’t hurt... <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)>Huh?
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Whuhhh? Where’d all my <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)> go?

... ... ...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)>Were you asleep this whole time?
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, hi, <$cdef(27)>Empoleon</color>! You look super cool, just like always!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>Heh heh, thank you. That’s very kind.

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, but your horns!
<$comeff(2,19)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,6)>They’re just a little bit dirty!

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Errr... Really? I suppose if it’s only a little bit, that’s
probably all ri—

<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,9)>No! It’s not OK! Your super cool horns <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>need to be pretty
and shiny all the time!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Here, I’ll clean them for you!
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>But...you just recently cleaned them for me.

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Here I go!
<$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,6)>Yah!<$motion(1,840)><$se2d(369)>
<$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,8)>Yah!<$motion(1,840)><$se2d(369)>
<$motion(2,815)><$voicel(2,10)>YAAAH!!!<$motion(1,841)><$se2d(370)>
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>OK! Now they’re all clean and shiny! <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>I gave you a FULL
POWER cleaning today, just like always!

<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>Yes, thank you. And as always, it’s appreciated...
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,1)>But next time, perhaps—if you would be so kind—you
could give me a half-power cleaning?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Hey, how come you and me are different colors?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Hmmm... Yeah, I wonder?
<$comeff(2,20)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh! I think I know! Maybe it’s ’cause <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>I nap a whole
bunch more?

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Huh? But I sleep just as much as you!
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh! I know! We like different berries!

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>You’re right, we do!
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>D’ya think our colors change based on the berries we eat?

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Yeah, that’s gotta be it!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, but wait... I’m pretty sure <$voicel(1,6)>I’ve always been this color,
ever since I was born...
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>What about you? How long have you been that color?
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Huh? Oh, I’ve been this color ever since I was born too!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm... Then maybe the berries we eat actually don’t
make any difference?

<$voicel(2,6)>*rumble*
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Gosh... Just THINKING about berries has got me
hungry now...
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m hungry too! Let’s eat some berries!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>Yeah! It’s berry time!

<$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>Oh nooo...
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)>I’m so hungryyy.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Hey...<$motion(1,803)> Uh—that egg you’re always carrying looks tasty.

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,4)>You can’t have it! This is my special egg!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>And aren’t you always carrying food around in your fur
anyway, <$cdef(27)>Munchlax? <$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)>Did you look reeeaaally carefully?

<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,16)>In my fur? Uh, hmmm. Let’s see...<$motion(1,817)> Ooh, here?
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Wow, you were right!<$motion(1,17)> It’s food tiiime! ♪
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,19)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,8)>Aah, that was super yummy!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,31)>If you eat it up that fast, you’re just gonna get hungry
again really soon!

<$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>Oh nooo...
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,17)>Now I want dessert.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)>That egg you’re always carrying looks tasty...
<$voicel(2,1)><$comeff(2,22)><$facial(2,10)><$motion(2,807)>I...<wait(0.2)>said...<wait(0.2)>NO! You can’t have it!
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,4)>It’s so round...and smooth...and, uh...food shaped.

<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>OK, look. I’m gonna tell you a secret. <$comeff(2,3)>This is actually just
a rock. <$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,3)>It’s not an egg at all!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,5)>No waaay!
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,18)>I had no idea. So does that mean rocks are, uh<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,1)>...actually
kinda tasty?
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,3)><$comeff(2,2)>Oh, come ooon!
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey, check this out!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>What’s up, yo? <wait(1.2)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Wh-whoa!!!

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah, it’s just some trash. It was super shiny, <$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>so I thought it
was treasure, but...guess not.

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Are you kiddin’ me?! This is totally treasure! What an
amazing find!
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Really?

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Just the right amount of filth... Not too dirty, not too clean.
And it smells awesome! It’s got my mouth waterin’, yo!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>I wanna dig in and scarf it all down right now!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Now you mention it, I guess it DOES look kinda special...

<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,9)>So, uh... You don’t need this for anything, right, <$cdef(27)>Meowth?
Can I have it? Pleeeaaase?

<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,9)>Huh? N-No way! <$comeff(1,11)>It’s mine! I’m the one who found it!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>This treasure belongs to ME!
<$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,5)>Awww... No way... I’m so jealous, yo!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>You know, every time I see you, your fur is so glossy and
beautiful.
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,23)><$motionoff(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>I get nervous just being close to you...
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,29)>Oh? Why might that be?

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,48)>Well, as you can see, my whole body is made up of
garbage.
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,18)>I’d never forgive myself if I dirtied your beautiful fur...
<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,807)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>No need to worry about that, dear. I’ll be fine.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, how very kind of you. You don’t mind getting dirty?

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,803)>I wouldn’t say that! I just don’t think it’s likely.
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>In fact, I have every confidence my fur will stay clean.
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,13)>Go ahead—touch it to your heart’s content.

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,4)><$motionoff(1,807)>Well, if you’re sure...here I go!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motionoff(1,816)><$comeff(1,10)>How’s this?
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,21)><$motionoff(2,816)>Well? What do you think?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,15)>My goodness! You don’t have so much as a speck of dust
on you! That really is impressive.

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)>Hopefully your concerns are put to rest!
My fur repels dust. ♪
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,827)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)><$textsize(0)>As long as it doesn’t repel every last bit of me...</textsize>

<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>ZORUA! Hey, you haven’t seen my captain around,
have ya?!
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Huh? Your captain? Uh-uh, I haven’t seen them.
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>Dang, really? Grrr... I can’t find them anywhere.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,4)>Ohhh...
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>OK! If I see them, I’ll tell you!
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, Captain! I was looking EVERYWHERE for you!
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>Well hi there, <$cdef(27)>Tatsugiri</color>! What’s up?
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Huh? Uhhh... You seem a little OFF today, Cap...
<$comeff(3,4)><$motion(3,807)><$voicel(3,5)>N-no, I’m totally fine! I’m definitely your captain!

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>I knew it—something IS off about you! You AREN’T my
captain! Um, I’m right... Right?

<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Darn it! I thought I did a really good job, too! How could
you tell?

<$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>Cap calls me something totally different! And the way you
were talking was totally off too!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Besides, if ANYONE is good at imitating the captain,
it’s me!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh yeah? Then go ahead and show me!

<$motion(2,634)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,10)>!!!
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Ha! I’m playing dead! Well, whatcha think?
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>You’re just lying down!

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,635)><$voicel(2,9)>Hehehe—naw, this is way harder than it looks! <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>You got at
least a million years to go before you’re ready to be
imitating my captain, kid!

<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Nnngh... I swear I’m gonna look EXACTLY like your
captain one day <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>and totally surprise you!

<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,807)>Um e-excuse me... Do...do you have a minute? I was...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>I was wondering... Can you teach me how to camouflage
the way you do?

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)><$pkcry;0(1,3)>? Sure, but...nobody’ll be able to see
your camouflage under that cloth.

<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Well, um...I was gonna take the cloth off once I learned
how to camouflage myself properly...

<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh. Well, if that’s what you want, <$cdef(27)>Mimikyu, I can teach
you...but it’s not super easy!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,3)>R-right. Yeah, OK... I guess that figures...

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Why do you wanna learn how to camouflage yourself,
anyway?

<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, since I don’t have any friends...<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>I thought...maybe if I
looked less scary, then other Pokémon would wanna be
friends with me.
<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? What do you mean? You and me are friends!

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Huh? Wait, what? Really? <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>Wow, I’m friends with <$cdef(27)>Zorua...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>That’s so cool! Heh heh heh...
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Hee hee! You’re so silly, <$cdef(27)>Mimikyu</color>!

<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)>*fwsh fwsh fwsh*
<$voicel(2,2)><$emotion(2,46)>Aww...no good, huh?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,9)>No! Don’t give up! Next time, give it more PASSION!
<$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Really DIG DEEP and get in there!

<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,12)>Um, OK!
<$voicel(2,4)><$motionoff(2,807)>*fwsh fwsh fwsh*
<$voicel(2,1)><$emotion(2,46)>Aww. Yeah... See what I mean? Generating electricity is
pretty tough.

<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>You can DO THIS, Pawmi! Try it gently this time! Almost
like...like you’re warming up an egg!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,666)><$facial(2,9)>Um, would you mind showing me what you mean,
<$cdef(27)>Dedenne?
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,3)>Hmmm? No chance, sorry! I can’t MAKE electricity at all!

<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,5)>Wha—? Then why are you giving me that
know-it-all advice?

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Because once you CAN make electricity, I want you to
share it with me sometimes!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>It’s totally fine! YOU! HAVE! THE! TALENT!
...Probably!

<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,663)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,18)>Oh. I’m just...shocked. I’ve been practicing so hard with
you, but still...

<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,800)><$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,1)>Shocked, huh? OK, great! Now take that shock and
SLAM it into your cheeks!

<$voicel(2,9)><$motionoff(2,807)><$facial(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)>Haaaaaa—AAAAAA— *fwsh fwsh fwsh*
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,859)>*crackle ZAP*
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,21)>I...I DID IT!
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)>YOU DID IT! Told ya so!
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,46)>My battery’s totally drained today. I can’t fly another inch!
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Sounds rough, yo.

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,64)>Hey, bud. Think you could spare a little electricity to help
charge me up?
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,59)>Sorry, dude. I’m totally out of battery today too.

<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Aw man! All right. Guess we’re both outta luck, huh...
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>I found a spot with tons of tasty-lookin’ berries, and I
<$voicel(2,8)><$motionoff(2,804)>reeeaaally wanted to take you there, but oh well...
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,15)>Yooo! Seriously?!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,51)>Yeah, but I guess there’s nothin’ we can do about it now,
is there. Real shame, though...

<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,4)>Hey, y’know what—uhhh... Hold up.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>Looks like I DO have a little electricity left, yo! <$voicel(1,8)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>I bet it’s
enough to get us to those berries! Let’s go!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>I was lying, ya dummy! And you fell for it!
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,56)>Whaaat?! It’s not cool to lie, yo...
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,48)>Hey, you lied first! Ugh, now I’m hungry.

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Things sure are peaceful around here, huh, Captain? Even
tiny weaklings like us don’t have much to worry about.
